text: URGENT URGENT no hot water and no heating at all since this morning, I have a baby in the house, this is unacceptable, I have called three times. 14b Alder Court. Please someone call me TONIGHT.

issues.summary_en: No heating and no hot water since this morning; a baby lives in the home and the tenant has called three times.
issues.explanation: Total loss of heating and hot water is an emergency, made more serious by a baby in the home.
